meta.name: Anthony Is Dead The Funeral Roast
meta.description: Smosh reawakens their breakout series [Blank] is Dead: The Funeral Roast for a night to DIE for! Anthony Padilla will Roast in Peace, and all of your favorite Smosh friends will be at his "Funeral" to make it so. With a musical halftime show, YouTuber guests, and the ability to submit your OWN roasts, this will be the WILDEST live show that you may ever attend!
meta.slogan: Smosh reawakens their breakout series [Blank] is Dead: The Funeral Roast for a night to DIE for!
